channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Protesters removed from chaotic Trump rally in Texas
item.description: Protesters were ejected from a Donald Trump rally in San Antonio, Texas, leading to a chaotic scene. Police removed individuals from the event. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Republican Mike Rogers Urges End to Canada Trade Dispute
item.description: U.S. Representative Mike Rogers, a Republican from Michigan, has called for an end to the trade dispute with Canada, which involves tariffs. This stance reportedly marks a departure from former President Donald Trump's policies. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Zack Polanski has stated his intention to run for leadership again and continue his pursuit of becoming a Member of Parliament (MP). However, coverage from multiple outlets suggests his political future is uncertain, with one report… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: South Korea Recalls Ukraine Ambassador Amid Diplomatic Dispute
item.description: South Korea has recalled its ambassador from Ukraine following a diplomatic dispute. The recall is reportedly linked to disagreements over prisoners of war. Ukraine has stated it is open to dialogue with South Korea regarding the situation. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: CEC faces calls for impeachment and sacking
item.description: Yogendra Yadav has called for the impeachment of the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC). Revanth Reddy has called for the BJP to sack the CEC. The coverage does not specify the reasons for these calls. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: In a significant administrative reshuffle in Jammu and Kashmir, 49 officers from the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Jammu and Kashmir Administrative Service (JKAS) have been transferred. The order for this major reshuffling was… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Opposition INDIA bloc to meet President Murmu over ECI concerns
item.description: A delegation of leaders from the INDIA bloc has secured an 8 p.m. appointment on Friday with President Droupadi Murmu. The opposition alliance sought the meeting to convey its concerns regarding the Election Commission of India (ECI). Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the 'Viksit Bharat Sankalp Sabha' at the Indira Gandhi Stadium, where he received a warm welcome. During the Seva Jyoti Programme, he affirmed "We Will Do It" and pledged for a 'Viksit Bharat'… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump Diverts European Aid to Latin America Amid Political Pressure
item.description: Amid political pressure, Donald Trump has reportedly diverted aid previously designated for Europe to Latin America instead. This action has drawn defiance from Democrats. Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.description: Former President Donald Trump has declared that anyone using the term Artificial Intelligence (AI) is an 'enemy' of the White House, particularly if they do not support his preferred terminology. A member of a Super Intelligence task force… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Ahead of the midterm elections, Republicans are emphasizing a "tough-on-crime" message and raising alarms about the potential long-term impact on the Supreme Court. The coverage suggests these issues are seen as significant stakes in the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Melaka, a state in Malaysia, will hold its state election on November 14, with nominations opening on October 26. The election involves nearly 700,000 voters. This comes as the Barisan Nasional (BN) coalition, led by Umno, is reportedly… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: President Donald Trump hosted a ceremony to award the National Medal of Science to six prominent tech leaders, including Satya Nadella and Elon Musk. The event garnered international attention. The Guardian reported the ceremony occurred… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.description: The United States lobbied allies, including the European Union, Canada, and Lithuania, to withdraw their sponsorship of a conference on disinformation, according to sources. This pressure led to the EU dropping its sponsorship of the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Donald Trump has appointed intelligence chief Kashyap Pramod "K.P." Patel as his AI czar and tasked him with heading a new task force focused on artificial intelligence. Patel is scheduled to visit top AI firms in Silicon Valley as part of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Italy Debates Electoral Law with Bonus Seats for Winners
item.description: Italy is considering a new electoral law that would grant bonus seats to parties or coalitions that win elections. The proposed legislation aims to provide a clearer mandate to the winning group. Details of the law are being debated. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Administration Actions on Peptides and Immigrant Children
item.description: The Trump administration is facilitating the temporary sale of certain unapproved peptides. Additionally, government lawyers will represent unaccompanied immigrant children. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump targets Somali immigrants in Minnesota rally
item.description: During a rally in Minnesota, former President Donald Trump urged attendees to 'fight back' against Somali immigrants. Meanwhile, a Minneapolis imam is pushing back against police who are linking recent violence to Somali American gangs. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Monique Ryan criticizes Josh Frydenberg's campaign tactics
item.description: Monique Ryan has stated that Josh Frydenberg is "focused on the past" and has accused his campaign of being "toxic." The specific details of the accusations or the context of the campaign were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Bangladesh has requested an extension of the Ganges water-sharing agreement with India and a guarantee for dry-season water supply. Dhaka hopes to finalize a deal before December 12. India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated that… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: Ninety-eight former civil servants have urged serving officers to uphold the values of the Constitution and resist unlawful orders, stating that dissent is increasingly being termed anti-national. The appeal emphasizes the importance of… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: Pargat Singh has been appointed as the new chief of the Punjab Congress. In a public display of unity, Sachin Pilot was seen driving Singh to the Golden Temple. Insiders describe Singh, a former Indian hockey captain and three-time MLA, as… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: INDIA bloc calls Odisha bandh, disrupting normal life
item.description: The INDIA bloc enforced a 12-hour bandh (strike) across Odisha, leading to disruptions in normal life. The Biju Janata Dal (BJD) party stayed away from the strike. The bandh was called by the INDIA bloc. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India Accuses Pakistan of Terror Doublespeak at UN
item.description: India has accused Pakistan of "terror doublespeak" at the United Nations, stating that the world has not forgotten the attacks of 9/11, 26/11, and the Pahalgam incident. This statement was made by India's representatives at the UN. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: PM Modi Reflects on 25 Years in Public Service
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi reflected on his 25-year journey in public service, stating he never anticipated contesting elections. This milestone marks a significant period in his democratic and public service career. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: German Far-Right AfD Secures First Regional Parliament Speaker Post
